Show an item with its criteria, place in the tree, blockers and linked threads

## Usage

```text
chainmail item show <id>
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail item show it_admin_work
chainmail item show it_01jcb7m2k9r8q3v4w5x6y7z8a9 --output json
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
